Name: Some Building Edits...
Author: TheMourningStar
Description:
12/19/23

Uh Hiya *Waves* Didn't even think this mod got any attention anymore.

Unfortunately I have not touched SD in a long time, and honestly not sure I could  update this mod if I wanted to do to loss of my original files, forgetting general modding for the game etc...

[size=5]So if its still of use, and anyone is so inclined to, feel free to use anything from this mod however you see fit. Mod it more, edit it share it, doesn't bother me at all.[/size]



[b]1/16/19[/b]

Just wanted to give a small update. 

We had a storm that surged my computer. All the image files I had everything saved to/working on were lost.

It might take a little bit, but I'm gonna try and use that parts from my mod to re-do the cabins and hopefully it will be done soon. I am currently super swamped with work, but I'm hoping to get around to it very soon.

(My cp seasons mod will take a bit longer to re-produce since that involved multiple versions of the buildings, along with the holiday/festival edits)

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-84#post-3321993]Here is a CP version by ColdAzrael[/url]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]
12/9/2018[/b]

There are now [b]2[/b] folders you can download:

-The first is the [b]main[/b] file. This contains every building edit. There is a preview on this page with what exactly is in it.

-The second is a couple [b]optional[/b] files. Inside the download each file is in its own folder. Pick the one you want and put it in the building folder and let it override the original file.

[i]These are just ordinary file replacements. You put them in your [/i][b]buildings folder[/b][i] and they overwrite the original files. Make sure to back up your files so you can change back to the original buildings if you want to later on.[/i]

[i]12/10/2018[/i]

[b]I just noticed the junimo hut is not in the preview, but want to let you know that it is included in the download.[/b]

[i]I will be working on a season version soon.[/i]
